metadata.title: AMD, CoreWeave Stocks Drop. Why Microsoft and Google Results Hit the AI Trade.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Chip and Cloud Stocks Stutter. Why Microsoft and Alphabet Earnings Hit the AI Trade.
Big Tech earnings aren’t giving the artificial-intelligence trade much of a boost on Thursday. Results from Microsoft and Alphabet raised as many questions about the sustainability of AI spending as they answered.
